body.heading: Where in the world is Azerbaijan?
paragraphs: Azerbaijan is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Azerbaijan is Baku.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Azerbaijan speak Azerbaijani and Armenian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Azerbaijan is the Azerbaijani manat.

body.heading: How big is Azerbaijan?
paragraphs: Azerbaijan covers about 87,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Cambodia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Inside Baku's ancient walls stand the Maiden Tower and the Palace of the Shirvanshahs, while just outside, the modern Flame Towers light up the Caspian shore.
Azerbaijan has hundreds of mud volcanoes — grey cones that bubble and plop cold mud. Nearby, Gobustan's rocks carry carvings made thousands of years ago.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Azerbaijan on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Azerbaijan in one breath: a country in Western Asia, capital Baku, where people speak Azerbaijani and pay with the Azerbaijani manat.
